Name: Season End Warning
Author: KirbbZ
Description:
[b]How many times have you woken up on the first day of Summer to find your entire Spring crop withered and dead?[/b]
It happens to everyone. Stardew Valley gives you almost no warning when the season is about to change — and by the time you remember, it's too late.
[b]Season's End Warning[/b] fixes that with a simple, unobtrusive HUD message every morning during the last few days of a season. It tells you exactly which crops are about to die, how many you have, and roughly how much gold you're about to lose if you don't get out there and harvest.
[line]
What You'll See
Starting 3 days before the season ends, you'll get a morning alert like this:
[quote]⚠ 2 days left in Spring! Cauliflower, 3x Potato, Parsnip will die! (~1,240g at risk)[/quote]On the final day of the season, you'll also get a full pop-up dialogue listing every at-risk crop by name — impossible to miss.
[line]
Smart Enough to Know What's Safe
The mod automatically ignores crops that don't need saving:
[list]
[*]✅ Greenhouse crops are excluded — they never die[/*]
[*]✅ Ginger Island farm crops are excluded[/*]
[*]✅ Multi-season crops like Ancient Fruit and Coffee are excluded[/*]
[*]✅ Already-dead crops are ignored[/*]
[*]✅ No warning at all if you have nothing at risk[/*]
[/list][line]
Fully Configurable
Open
[code]config.json[/code]or use [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional) to adjust:
[list]
[*]How many days before season end warnings start (default: 3)[/*]
[*]Whether to show the gold loss estimate[/*]
[*]Whether to list crop names or just the count[/*]
[*]Whether to suppress warnings when nothing is at risk[/*]
[/list][line]
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional but recommended for easy in-game configuration.
[line]
Compatibility
Works with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and all other major farm expansion mods. Compatible alongside other notification mods — this one only handles end-of-season crop warnings and won't overlap with birthday or tool upgrade alerts.
[line]
[i]If this mod saved your harvest, an endorsement goes a long way — it helps other farmers find it![/i]
